searchText: Added to the next call's agenda for discussion 👍 Assuming we do decide to include these 3 as CFI for Shanghai, it's probably worth a discussion about everything else that's on the table so we can make sure that we don't overcommit early on. As a reminder, there's a good list of proposals here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/450 FWIW (and not sure who the right person is to contact), is it possible to get https://launchpad.ethereum.org/en/select-client updated with client diversity %s? It might help folks that are new stakers select a minority client. thx. I'd assume more people will select the majority if that happens. fair point... even if I do quite like prysm, I do believe there is some wisdom then in recommending on that site the other clients.. and leave off the #s.. at least until such time as the % is lower than 2/3rds.. thx. I suggested to leave off the #’s and sort them from least to most used as most will use the first option 😛 Very true! 😄 On that note, you should probably remove OpenEthereum from the Eth1 client list will forward onto that team
